findings.observation: The assertion compares two independently reduced [0,2pi) atan2 coordinates as ordinary real values. The actual declared strip partition includes midpoint t=1/2, where floating transverse sin(pi) and atan2 rounding can put equivalent directions on opposite 0/2pi sides.
findings.impact: A periodic-coordinate representation difference can reject a physically identical transverse antipode; this is a test-oracle defect, not an error in the rational certification API.
findings.minimal_correction: Compare math.remainder(atan2(-y,-x)-atan2(y,x)-math.pi,2*math.pi) to0 using the existing places=12. Preserve tests, tolerances, scientific code and runtime budgets.
